content: Rewitsixi
Merikɨte Rawiri waɨkawa 'ukiratsitɨtɨri yuniwe Tsarumuni kananukakeni ti'aitame mayanikɨ 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie.
Yunaime 'ixaheritsixi wa'ukiyarima kaniwarukuxeɨrieni meta mawari wewiwamete metatsiere rewitsixi.
Hikɨ rewitsixi mekaniuti'inɨatsieni, xeitewiyari heimana tamamata wiyari memɨhɨtɨkatei, meputipaɨmerixɨ xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'atahaika miriyari (38.000) 'ukitsi.

Mɨkɨ, xeitewiyari heimana nauka miriyari (24.000) meyupaɨmetɨ Yawé tukieya manuwe mepɨhɨritɨariekai 'uximayatsika, meta 'ataxewi miriyari meyupaɨmetɨ ti'aitame 'aurie meputi'ukai hipatɨta mepɨ'itsɨkatetɨkai,
nauka miriyari kitenie tehɨwemete mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai, hipatɨta nauka miriyari Yawé hetsiemieme kwikamete mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai kanaritekɨ, Rawiri miti'aitakai mɨpaɨ 'ayumieme.
Hikɨ Rawiri rewitsixi me'ayehaikame kaniwarayeitɨani Rewi niwemama kememɨyupaɨmekai, mekanihɨkɨtɨni: Keritsuni, Kuhati meta Merari.
Keritsunitsixi
Keritsuni niwemama: Rarani meta Tsimi.
Rarani niwemama mepɨyuhaikakai: Kehieri puwamatsikatɨkai, Tsetani meta Kuheri.
Mɨkɨ mepakɨ Rarani nuiwarimama wa'ukiyarima. Tsimi yuhaikame pɨwarayexei: Tserumiti, Katsiheri meta Karani.
Tawari Tsimi niwemama yunaukatɨ mepakɨ: Yakati, Tsitsa, Kehutsi meta Weriya. Mɨkɨ Tsimi niwemama mepakɨ.

Yakati wamatsika pɨhɨkɨtɨkai, Tsitsa hutarieka mieme. 'Ikɨ Kehutsi meta Weriya matɨa waɨkawa tɨɨri memɨkawarayexeikɨ, xeinuiwari memɨhɨkɨtɨni hepaɨ xeikɨa mepɨte'inɨatsiekai, yunaitɨ xei'uximayatsikayari mepupitɨarie.
Kuhatitsixi
Kuhati niwemama mepɨyunaukakai: 'Amirani, 'Itsaxi, Hewuruni meta 'Utsiheri.

'Amirani niwemama mepakɨ, 'Aruni meta Muitsexi. 'Aruni meta nuiwarimama mepanayexeiyarie mawari memɨwewiekakɨ yemekɨ mɨpatsietɨka, 'ɨkwa memukutaiyanikɨ, Yawé hetsiemieme memɨte'uximayakakɨ meta Kakaɨyari memɨwawiriekakɨ 'aixɨa muwayuriekakɨ teɨteri.
Muitsexi, tewi Kakaɨyari menayexei, meta niwemama mekaniu'inɨatsieni Rewi nuiwarimama wahamatɨa.
Muitsexi niwemama mepakɨ, Keritsuni meta 'Eriyetsexi.
Keritsuni nu'aya matɨarieya patɨa, Tsewuheri.
'Eriyetsexi xeime xeikɨa payexei yuniwe, Xekawiyaxi patɨa, mɨkɨ hɨrixɨa waɨkawa yuniwema puwarayexei.
'Itsaxi nu'aya mexɨakame patɨa Tserumiti.
Hewuruni nu'aya mexɨakame patɨa Keriyaxi, hutarieka mieme 'Amariyaxi, hairieka mieme Kahatsieri, naurieka mieme Kekamani.
'Utsiheri nu'aya mexɨakame patɨa Mikahiyaxi, hutarieka mieme 'Itsiyaxi pɨtitewakai.
Meraritsixi
Merari niwemama mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai Makiri meta Mutsihí. Makiri niwemama mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai 'Eriyatsaxi meta Kihitsi.
'Eriyatsaxi tɨɨri 'ukitsi kawarayexeiyaka kaniumɨni: 'ukari xeikɨa pɨwarayexei. Mɨkɨ yatewa yu'iwama mepɨwarutiwitɨ Kihitsi niwemama.
Mutsihí yuniwema yuhaikame puwarayexei: Makiri, 'Eraxi meta Keremuti.

'Ikɨ Rewi nuiwarimama mepɨhɨkɨ, niwemama yuxexuitɨ kememɨteyutamɨiriyaxɨ. 'Ana mepaka'utsie kemɨtetewakai wa'ukiyarima. Mɨkɨ mepɨte'uximayakai Yawé tukieya manuwe 'amemɨyumate xeikɨa, xeitewiyari heima meutiyune wiyari xeikɨa mepexeiyatɨkatei.
Rawiri mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Kepauka paitɨtɨ Yawé, 'ixaheritsixi takakaɨyari, yuteɨterima mɨtatsi'anukayatsaxɨ meta yukie mayeitɨa yuheyemekɨ Kerutsareme kiekariyatsie,
pɨkaheuyewetseri rewitsixi tuki memɨkutɨtɨwenikɨ meta piinitɨarika muwa mawaritsie timieme».
'Imatɨrieka Rawiri kemɨtiu'aitaxɨ, yunaitɨ rewitsixi xeitewiyari wiyari memɨhɨtɨka mekanaka'utsieni memɨteta'uximayatakɨ,

'Aruni nuiwarimama memɨwaparewienikɨ, Yawé tukieya manuwe memɨteta'uximayatakɨ. Takwa mepɨhɨritɨariekai meta kiita 'etsimuyeyeyeuta yaxeikɨa meta mepɨhɨritɨariekai piinite mawaritsie timieme memɨteti'itiwanikɨ, meta hipame 'uximayatsika tuki hetsiemieme.

Yaxeikɨata mepɨhɨritɨariekai paa Kakaɨyari hɨxie mieme, meta tɨriku mɨtɨxiyari 'aixɨa mɨ'ane hatsite mawariyari hetsiemieme, harina papayari mɨkakuxanariyarietɨka meta mawari mɨtixarikietɨka mɨti'etsarietɨka metatsiere te'inɨnɨatamete naime hepaɨtsita mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai.
Mepɨhɨritɨariekai ximeri meta taikai memɨ'axenikɨ pamɨpariyutsi memipitɨakakɨ meta meminɨawanikɨ Yawé.

Metatsiere mepɨhɨritɨariekai mawari taiyariyari memutiwewiwanikɨ Yawé hetsiemieme mutiwewiwakai xawatikɨ meta metseri 'etsimɨpenitsie meta hipatɨ 'ixɨarari maye'axenitsie. Mɨpaɨ yamekateni'uximayakaitɨni Yawé hetsiemieme yayupapaɨmetɨ, kememɨte'aitɨariekai.
Mɨpaɨ mepɨtehɨritɨariekai 'ixuriki tukiyari memɨ'ɨwiyanikɨ meta tuki muyepatsie. Kepauka memɨte'uximayakai Yawé tukieyata, wa'iwama 'Aruni nuiwarimama yametewarahɨawekaku mepɨte'uximayakai.
